meta.title: Stress Testing Infrastructure & Scenario Configuration
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create stress testing infrastructure with configurable YAML scenarios to enable repeatable stress tests with different parameters.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Directory structure created: tests/live/stress/ with scenarios/ and results/
Scenario YAML schema supports: name, type (network|throughput|long_running|error), duration, parameters, success_criteria
Pytest fixtures for loading and executing scenarios available
Sample scenario files demonstrate schema for each test type
Stress test results logged in structured JSON format

key-tasks.task: Define scenario schema with Pydantic models
Create sample scenarios (network_disconnect, high_throughput, long_running_24h, api_error_simulation)

architecture-context.pattern: YAML configuration files define test parameters without code changes
architecture-context.constraint: Scenarios must be parameterizable without code changes (NFR25)

technical-specifications.spec:
class StressScenario(BaseModel): name: str type: Literal["network", "throughput", "long_running", "error"] duration: int # seconds parameters: dict[str, Any] success_criteria: SuccessCriteria
class StressTestResult(BaseModel): scenario_name: str start_time: str # ISO format end_time: str duration_seconds: float passed: bool metrics: dict[str, Any] errors: list[str]

name: network_disconnect_recovery type: network duration: 300 parameters: disconnect_count: 5 disconnect_interval_seconds: 60 max_reconnect_time_seconds: 30 success_criteria: all_reconnections_successful: true max_reconnection_time_seconds: 30
